gen-dafont-bloody-gf-noto-sans-chakma: Noto Sans Chakma reads friendly and compact, its lowercase standing tall against the capitals with open mouths on every s and c. Bloody then lands above it with big round bowls, loud and dripping with command, and the body quietly lets it.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-noto-sans-cham: Big round lowercase bowls give Bloody a commanding, bloody swagger, while Noto Sans Cham sits below in tall, rounded, modern forms. Its entries stay wide.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-noto-sans-cherokee: Loud and bloody up top. Noto Sans Cherokee follows in a tall band of letters with short stalks, and its e leaves a wide gap at the terminal, so Bloody gets room to bellow.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-noto-sans-chorasmia: Noto Sans Chorasmian reads contemporary and large, its curves stopping short instead of closing in, with short ascenders overhead. And Bloody does the shouting, round-bowled and commanding, where the body simply carries the text.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-noto-sans-coptic: Bloody hits hard, all big round bowls and bloody attitude. Noto Sans Coptic then fills the line with a dense middle zone, its s and c mouths staying open and uncrowded.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-noto-sans-cuneiform: Bloody's big round lowercase bowls are what you notice first. Noto Sans Cuneiform backs them with swollen, glass-bead lowercase and an e that opens up, so both fonts feel inflated but only one is shouting.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-noto-sans-deseret: Noto Sans Deseret reads approachable and clean, with open apertures and a wide-looking lowercase under squat ascenders. And a full page of it stays easy going, never crowding itself, while Bloody keeps its commanding bowls to the heading.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-noto-sans-devanagar: Bloody brings commanding, bloody bowls to the top, and Noto Sans Devanagari sits beneath it in a compact skyline with an open-curved g. Their gap is the whole appeal.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-noto-sans-duployan: Commanding and bloody, Bloody throws its big round bowls across the heading. Noto Sans Duployan follows with a wide-mouthed a and oversized counters, giving that heavy display voice something open to rest against.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-noto-sans-elbasan: Noto Sans Elbasan reads large and contemporary, with open terminals. Bloody handles the commanding, round-bowled drama, whereas the sans-serif body handles steady, tightly cleared text.
